Hi Tara — great to hear from you.

Thanks for sending the COI. For secure uploads we have two options:
1) Procurement portal upload (preferred): I will create a limited-access intake folder for EdgeBridge and send portal credentials — this is where we store COIs/W9s and risk questionnaires. Please confirm the contact who will upload (email address) and whether you need SSO/SAML.
2) Encrypted SFTP (alternative): If you require SFTP, let me know and I will loop in infra for ephemeral credentials.

To get a PO started we need:
- Signed vendor agreement (if not already completed) or approval to use our standard MSA
- Completed W9 (PDF)
- Confirmation on whether you will accept Redwood's standard Additional Insured wording or if you need a specific endorsement.

Action items:
- Tara: confirm upload contact and whether you want portal or SFTP (ideally portal).
- Tara: upload W9 to the portal once credentials arrive.
- Kimberly: will you own the PO creation and advise on whether a conditional PO is acceptable pending final endorsement?

Kimberly/Marissa — looping you in to expedite the PO and note any finance constraints. If procurement can issue a conditional PO pending an endorsement, we can start work while the insurance ops team completes the review.

Jordan Blake
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
